description: From XP's connected resale order book. Two-phase write on the XP live offer book. Use when the user wants to make an offer on an open XP listing (e.g. 'make an offer of $50 on this'). Call with `confirm=False` first to preview the fee-inclusive total (no bid placed); call with `confirm=True` only after the user explicitly approves the previewed amount. Only confirm=True submissions return success=true. Do not use without the two-phase preview-then-confirm flow. Requires auth and write:bids scope. Do not use for browse / discovery; this is a marketplace transaction tool that places real money at risk. For standard buy-now ticket purchases without a bid, use `search_events` and `get_ticket_listings`.

amount_cents.description: Deprecated, use amount_per_ticket_usd. Integer cents per ticket, multiple of 100.

amount_per_ticket_usd.description: Whole dollars per ticket (50 = $50.00), the same unit create_standing_bid takes. Cents are not accepted: XP rejects fractional-dollar bids. Preview returns the total.

confirm.description: Defaults to false, a preview of the computed total. Set true to place the offer once the user agrees.

name: make_offer_on_listing
title: Make Offer on Listing
